name: Pulmonary Embolism
description: A blockage in one of the pulmonary arteries in the lungs, usually caused by blood clots that travel from the deep veins of the legs or other parts of the body.
common_symptoms: Sharp chest pain that may worsen with deep breaths
Leg swelling or pain (sign of deep vein thrombosis)
associated_symptoms: Anxiety or sense of impending doom
risk_factors: Prolonged immobility (e.g., long flights, bed rest)
physical_examination: Leg swelling or tenderness (sign of DVT)
recommended_investigations: ECG (may show sinus tachycardia or right‑heart strain)

clinical_references.title: Venous thromboembolic diseases: diagnosis, management and thrombophilia testing
